verdict.rationale: First-party README evidence shows a `llama serve -hf <model>` command that launches a local server for a loaded GGUF model, with a built-in web UI running against it and a dedicated Server section. Nothing in the pack says the server's API is OpenAI-compatible, which is the core of the story. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of OpenAI-compatible endpoints (e.g. /v1/chat/completions), API documentation detail, and independent or hands-on corroboration of using the server as an API.
